_comment: Source of truth for the Poncelet diagram & timeline. Facts verified 2026-08-05 against imo-official.org, stats.ioinformatics.org, maths-olympiques.fr and Akram's LinkedIn-profile PDF. Unknown values are null — never guess. ORDER: chronological ascending — always APPEND new achievements at the END; the renderer places the LAST entry at the top vertex and walks backward in time in the positive (counterclockwise, trigonometric) direction. Logos: null means no official image logo exists (BMO, BxMO, OFM) — the UI renders a typographic shortName chip instead.

achievements.title: 7th Place — BeCP 2022
achievements.description: First national ranking in competitive programming, in C++.

achievements.title: Silver Medal — BxMO 2023
achievements.description: Silver medal at the 2023 Benelux Mathematical Olympiad.

achievements.title: First Place — OMB 2023
achievements.description: National champion of the Belgian Mathematical Olympiad, MAXI category — the first of two consecutive titles.

achievements.title: 5th Place — BeCP 2023
achievements.description: Improved national ranking in competitive programming.

achievements.title: Silver Medal — OFM 2023
achievements.description: Silver medal at the 2023 Francophone Mathematical Olympiad.

achievements.title: Honorable Mention — IMO 2023
achievements.description: First IMO participation; Honorable Mention at the 64th IMO in Japan.

achievements.title: Gold Medal — OFM 2024
achievements.description: Gold medalist at the 2024 Francophone Mathematical Olympiad, one year after silver.

achievements.title: First Place — OMB 2024
achievements.description: Belgian national champion for the second consecutive year.

achievements.title: Silver Medal — BMO 2024
achievements.description: Silver medal at the 41st Balkan Mathematical Olympiad, competing with the French guest team; France finished 4th of 23 teams.

achievements.title: 4th Place & IOI Qualification — BeCP 2024
achievements.description: Best national ranking (7th → 5th → 4th over three years), earning selection for the International Olympiad in Informatics.

achievements.title: Silver Medal — IMO 2024
achievements.description: Silver medal at the 65th IMO with 22 points (7, 7, 0, 7, 1, 0) — on the medal boundary — one year after his Honorable Mention.

achievements.title: Contestant — IOI 2024
achievements.description: Represented Belgium at the 36th IOI, competing across six algorithmic tasks over two contest days.

achievements.title: First Place — MMC 2025
achievements.description: National champion of the Moroccan undergraduate mathematics contest — the first of two consecutive titles.

achievements.title: First Place — MMC 2026
achievements.description: Defended the national title: first place at the 2026 MMC, back to back with 2025.

achievements.title: 3rd Worldwide — IMC 2026
achievements.competition: International Mathematics Competition for University Students
achievements.description: Third place on the planet at IMC 2026, awarded a Gold Medal and Grand First Prize while competing for the Math&Maroc team — the achievement this site celebrates.
